description: Ask WhatsDownNow to start monitoring a service that is not in the catalog yet. Humans can also do this at /request. Votes for the same name are counted together. Optional url helps us find the site; optional reason is noted. Optional email is only used to notify the requester when the service is added (double opt-in; never marketing). If the name already matches a tracked service, the live slug is returned instead of a new request.

email.description: Optional address to notify when it's added (we send a confirmation link; never marketing)

reason.description: Why this service should be added (optional)

name: request_service
title: Request a service be added
